title: Countries & institutions
description: Define the countries and institutions of an exercise, the catalogue of expected actions, and the mandate registry that the gap rules rely on.
noCountriesHint: Create the first country, then its institutions.
cannotDeleteHint: “{{name}}” is referenced by an exercise or another record and cannot be deleted. Archive it instead: it stays in past exercises but disappears from new ones.
codeHint: Letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore (max 32). Cannot be changed later.
registryReviewHint: Until an institution's registry is “reviewed complete”, an absent mandate can never be described as a documented gap: gaps are downgraded to inferred.
noMandatesHint: Add mandates by hand with a source from a knowledge base, or import a CSV.
importCsvHint: Imported rows start as “proposed”. Run a dry run first.
actionsHint: What a situation requires. Actions authored by the scenario designer are flagged in reports: they are never an official institutional obligation.
label: Label
